test_title: PYST 62: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 13 Nov, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

Statements:

Some salaries are bonus.

All wages are bonus.

Conclusions:

(I) Some salaries are wages.

(II) Some wages are salaries.
solution:
The least possible venn diagram is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a9ee5d667940999809aae8572bc817098aaade207421cfc9e8f5394728292050.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some salaries are wages → False (There is no direct relation given between salaries and Wages. it is possible but not definite)

(II) Some wages are salaries → False (There is no direct relation given between salaries and Wages. it is possible but not definite)

Here, Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows..

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".
